thread:
Chris Vaughn: quick PSA  found a cross-link regression in the evaluation playbook. the section "Results validation" links to #metrics-summary but the heading slug on the target page changed to #metrics_overview. users hit a 404 fragment during the demo.
Elena Park: ugh. thanks for catching. which file?
Chris Vaughn: content/kb/eval/playbook.md -> line ~210. target is content/kb/eval/analysis.md.
Tariq Ahmed: I can patch the link. prefer to standardize on hyphenated anchors instead of underscores.
DocsBot: Link-scan: fragment mismatch detected: playbook.md -> #metrics-summary (expected) but analysis.md has #metrics_overview. Scan run: 2025-08-21T13:05:02Z.
Elena Park: let's update the heading on analysis.md to be "Metrics summary" (slug: #metrics-summary) so legacy links keep working, and add a test in the docs linter to catch underscore vs dash mismatches.
Tariq Ahmed: created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/9481 (one-line heading tweak + linter rule). patch note includes grep that found 7 occurrences of #metrics_overview across repo.
Chris Vaughn: can you paste the grep you used? want to double-check other backlinks I maintain.
Tariq Ahmed: yessir:
```bash
grep -R "#metrics_overview\b" content | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Elena Park: added a tiny test in docs-lint that warns on "_" in fragment IDs. not failing the build yet, just a warn. we can make it fail after a week. PR updated.
CloudInfra: FYI if you change heading text we may need to re-run static preview cache invalidation for older previews. I'll queue a cache purge job after merge.
Chris Vaughn: ran local preview, links resolve. left a small nit in the PR about commit msg format.
Tariq Ahmed: amended commit with Conventional Commit style and pushed. CI green. cc @Elena @CloudInfra
DocsBot: PR #9481 merged by Tariq Ahmed at 2025-08-21T13:27:33Z. Post-merge: link-check re-run queued.
CloudInfra: cache purge scheduled (RW-2561) for 2025-08-21 14:00 UTC. will post if anything regresses.
Elena Park: thanks team. i've created a short follow-up RW ticket to audit fragment styles across KB (RW-2562). assigning to docs-owners.
Chris Vaughn: great, leaving this thread for async follow-ups. if anyone spots more underscore fragments ping me and i'll grep them. :thumbsup:
